items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: We had a little neighborhood band. And, uh, Harold, you remember the boys. Peter DePass. Oh, yeah. And, uh, Alvarez Perez. Yeah. And I used to play the piano.

ctx.x: It looks like a microphone. It's something up here. Peter?
No, you talk about sweet trumpet. Oh, sweet.
